layman_headline: Portfolio fully deployed in a fearful market — patience is the play right now.
layman_explanation: We're holding three positions (SOL, LINK, and FET) that are all slightly underwater, each down about 0.5-1.2%. The broader crypto market is in a 'Fear' state at 31/100, with Bitcoin dominance high at 56.5%, which means altcoins are struggling. None of our positions have hit stop-losses, and none of the new candidates on the watchlist offer a compelling enough setup to justify adding a fourth position in this environment.
layman_action: Hold your current positions and wait. All three trades are within normal ranges — no stop-losses triggered. Don't add new risk in a fearful, BTC-dominant market with weak altcoin setups.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate pool is extremely weak this cycle. VELVET just crashed 41.8% in 24h after a 42% weekly run — classic pump-and-dump pattern, RSI at 60 after that dump suggests more downside. MON has an RSI of 39 approaching oversold but lacks any catalyst, MACD data, or volume confirmation — it's a falling knife in a high BTC-dominance environment. The remaining candidates are stablecoins (FDUSD, USDG, RLUSD) or gold-backed tokens (XAUT, PAXG) with no swing trade potential. SOL, LINK, and FET are already held, covering the best altcoin opportunities. With Fear & Greed at 31 and BTC dominance at 56.5%, this is not the environment to aggressively add altcoin exposure. All three existing positions have reasonable risk/reward ratios with stops intact.
